nodes.label: Disk as Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Ephemeral CLI sessions may never appear in state.db while messages.jsonl remains available, so database absence is treated as normal.

nodes.label: Process Completion Protocol
nodes.rationale: Completion requires process exit and stdout drain; silence is not completion evidence, and unresolved cases retain explicit states.

nodes.label: Prompt Marker Correlation
nodes.rationale: A unique marker distinguishes concurrent runs that use the same prompt because the CLI does not reveal its created session ID.

nodes.label: Exec and REPL Routing
nodes.rationale: Exec is reserved for judgment-heavy research, while REPL handles deterministic fetch, crawl, and save operations to control cost and nondeterminism.

nodes.label: Modular CLI Design
nodes.rationale: Modules keep one responsibility and stay below 400 lines, while the entry point only wires argparse and dispatch, to preserve test seams and reviewability.

nodes.label: Bounded Prompt Cost Control
nodes.rationale: Daemon-side work cannot be cancelled from the CLI, so bounded objectives are the only reliable cost control.
